extension.name: com_authors
extension.author: FreeExtraChips Editorial
extension.description:
FreeExtraChips editorial team profiles, methodology pages, and trust hub.
V2.7.94 — Slots index: the hero gap, for real - 2.7.93 raised padding-top on .slt-index-main but fec-edition.css sets .fecx .wrap { padding: 0 28px } later at equal specificity, so it never applied (nor did the old 20px). Now .fecx.slt-index-page .slt-index-main.wrap carries the top padding (36px, 28px on phones) and restates the side gutters.
V2.7.93 — Slots index: more air under the hero - .slt-index-main padding-top 20px -> 36px, so the at-a-glance row no longer sits on the stats strip.
V2.7.92 — Slots index: phone layout - Hero strip: labels wrap instead of truncating ("Highest RTP · Mega J…"); under 640px the fifth cell (last verification) spans the whole last row, cells are tighter. - Provider chips: one horizontally scrollable row on phones instead of six wrapped ones; the active chip scrolls into view. - Toolbar: two-column grid under 640px, search and "with active bonuses" full width, count on its own line. - Cards: one column under 480px (the richer card did not fit two columns at 402px), slightly larger RTP figures than the old two-column phone rule.
V2.7.91 — Slots index (/slots): database page with order, filters and pages - Hero strip with live numbers over the whole database: slots documented, providers, multi-tier titles, highest RTP on file (with the slot name), last verification (relative date computed in the browser from data-ts, the page is edge-cached). - At-a-glance row above the grid: highest RTP on file, widest tier spread, verified most recently, three entries each. Hidden on a provider-filtered page. - Toolbar in the house .wp-controls style: order (recently verified, RTP high/low, widest spread, most bonuses, max win, newest release, A to Z), RTP tiers, RTP band (97%+, 96-97, below 96), volatility, search, "with active bonuses only", and a "Showing X of N" count. Client side over the server-rendered cards, state written to the URL with replaceState, read back on load (sort, tier, rtp, vol, bonus, q, p). Without JavaScript the full grid stays visible in server order. - Pager at 24 cards per page with "Show all", same .fec-pg nav as the package and payout indexes; nothing paginates server side, so no ?start= URLs. - Provider chips filter in place on the full page and keep working as /slots/p/ links on a filtered page and without JavaScript. - Cards gain a facts row (tier count and spread in pp, max win, release year), a verified line (date + editor), a "97%+" badge with a teal edge, "No active bonus" instead of silence, and data-* attributes for the sort keys. - Server order is now freshness (last_verified_date, published_at, name) instead of active-bonus count; the model also returns rtp_variants_json, release_year, provider_value and the verifying author (LEFT JOIN casino_authors). - JSON-LD: the CollectionPage gets a mainEntity ItemList with the documented slots (max 100). Legend "How to read a card" under the grid, linked from the hero. - No schema change (2.7.91.sql is a no-op).
V2.7.90 — Welcome Package Index: two legibility fixes - Rows where a leg is priced at the deposit maximum (core flag cap_unreachable) carry a "<=" mark in the You deposit column with the reason in the tooltip; rule 3 of "How to read" names it. On those rows banner / deposit is not the effective match, and the page now says why instead of looking wrong (Goldbet.io, 550% up to $11,500, $4,000 deposited, 138%). - FAQ "How can an X% banner come out at Y%?" takes X and Y from the widest gap on the page and names the casino; the fixed 2,000% / 57% example matched no listed package.
V2.7.89 — Payout Index: the register says what it measures - "Register data" is the latest data point (newest desk request or newest player receipt); the clock statistics rebuild no longer moves it, so it stops reading as today's date. - "vs declared" prints the signed gap to the minute; "on time" only when measured equals declared (the +/-6 min tolerance is gone). - FXShield tier badge beside each desk-tested casino (live register only); FAQ "Does a fast payout mean the casino is safe?" points to it. - A brand whose first clock is still running joins the collection table (0 of N, 1 running); the separate running band shows only while that table is empty. Running list and count skip brands the desk has closed, suspended or blacklisted, like the two tables. - FAQ "Why is the list so short?" and the Updates rule reworded to match the tables as they are.
V2.7.88 — Dashboard: the "create new game" provider select lists the site vocabulary - models/dashboard.php getProviders() returns the union of the jReviews software field options (jr_soft, the set the Blog Desk uses) and the providers already in #__games, merged on the normalised name and sorted by name. Before, only #__games was read, so a provider with no active game yet was not offered. When both sides know a provider the value of the existing games wins; a provider known only to jr_soft takes its option value. assets/dashboard.js prints the game count only when above 0. No SQL.
V2.7.87 — FXRate: casino exclusion aligned with the listings - models/packageindex.php casinoExcluded() and the methodology FXRate stats use the core's fec_fxrate_casino_excluded() (core 0.5.1): any non-empty jr_closed / jr_suspended / jr_blacklisted excludes the casino, as every listing query does (jr_x = ''). Before, the index kept a casino suspended with a wording other than "susp" (or blacklisted with one other than "bl"/"yes"), the stricter pattern of fec_should_noindex_casino(). Same rule inline when the core predates 0.5.1. No SQL.
V2.7.86 — FXRate rules v1.3: spins wagering - A leg's free spins carry their own wagering term, apart from the match's (schema 3 spins_wr; core 0.5.0 / render 1.3.0 print "spins: no wagering" / "spins: 40x winnings" / "spins: WR not stated" under the match's term in the ladder). Methodology: rule "Spins wagering (v1.3)", versioning entry, the free-spins FAQ says the line prints it; the index's "Free spins and currencies" rule says the same. 2.7.86.sql sets the fxrate topic to v1.3 / 2026-10-19. Numbers unchanged.
V2.7.85 — Welcome Package Index: casino chips - Both tables print the site's casino chip (the initial on the brand's own hue) before the casino name, via fec_casino_chip() at 28px when the common lib is loaded, else a local fallback with the same algorithm (crc32 of the lowercased name mod 360) so the colour matches the cards and heroes. Markup: the cell content is wrapped in .wp-cas (flex) with the text in .wp-cas-txt; page.css adds the three rules. Decorative only (aria-hidden), nothing else changes. No SQL.
V2.7.84 — Welcome Package Index: track labels for linked packages - A package with the generic title "Welcome Package" that is linked to another one of the same casino (alt_of, either direction) is named by its opener's type: High Roller Package (hr), Crypto Package (crypto), Standard Package (su). Rows read "High Roller Package · alternative to the Standard Package" and the reverse instead of both saying "alternative to the Welcome Package". A stored title always wins; a casino with one package still shows no track label. models/packageindex.php rows carry opener_type and track_label (render 1.2.1 does the same on the bands and the casino block). No SQL.
V2.7.83 — FXRate: alternative tracks (alt_of) - Welcome Package Index: models/packageindex.php selects p.alt_of and gives every row title_full, alt_of and alt_titles (the packages of the same casino linked as alternatives, either direction, among those listed); both tables print "alternative to the <title>" under the track title; reading rule "Two packages at one casino"; page.css .wp-alt. - methodology/fxrate: reading rule "Two packages at one casino". No SQL (alt_of has been in the packages table since schema 1; the dashboard panel now sets it, render 1.2.0 prints it).
V2.7.82 — Welcome Package Index: "Terms stated" counts complete legs - In the Awaiting-terms table a leg counts as stated only with both its match rate and its cap (or as a spins leg): a package whose four legs all have a rate but one lacks a cap read "4 of 4" while unpriced; it now reads "3 of 4", which names the missing piece. Header carries a title saying so. No SQL.
V2.7.81 — FXRate rules v1.2: maximum cashout on legs - Requires schema 2 of jos_fec_bonus_package_legs (max_cashout, max_cashout_kind; fxrate_schema2.sql) and calc core 0.4.0: the index and the methodology stats select the two columns (the row's own for real legs) and pass them to the core. - Welcome Package Index: rows carry cashout_capped (positions); both tables mark capped packages with a triangle in the Deposits column (title says why), a checkbox "Hide packages with a max cashout" joins the controls, reading rule "Maximum cashout" added; page.css .wp-capped. - methodology/fxrate: reading rule "Maximum cashout" (reported as stated, never priced), versioning v1.2; 2.7.81.sql sets the topic version.
V2.7.80 — FXRate: entry line documented - methodology/fxrate: reading rule "The entry line" (core 0.3.2 / render 1.0.5: the stated minimum deposits added up against the deposit needed to collect every cap, shown under the four numbers when every summed leg states a minimum) and the v1.1 changelog entry extended (entry line, sub-unit money with up to eight decimals). No SQL.
V2.7.79 — FXRate rules v1.1: spins legs - A deposit that buys free spins and no match ("3rd deposit: 100 free spins") is a spins leg: counted as a deposit of the ladder, its spins in the headline, left out of the four numbers, which price the match legs alone (calc core fec_fxrate.php 0.3.0, leg kind 'spins'; render 1.0.4). Before, such a leg kept the whole package at "not stated". - methodology/fxrate: reading rule "Spins legs", versioning list (v1.1 / v1.0), one FAQ; 2.7.79.sql sets the topic version to v1.1. models/methodology.php getFxrateStats() passes leg spins to the core so the counts follow the rule. - Welcome Package Index: models/packageindex.php passes leg spins to the core, counts a spins leg as stated, exposes spins_legs; both tables mark such packages with a star in the Deposits column (title says why); reading rule 5 extended; page.css .wp-spinsleg.
V2.7.78 — Welcome Package Index: canonical path - The page's own URL is AuthorsModelPackageindex::INDEX_PATH (/bonuses/welcome-packages), no longer the JRoute menu route, which carried the parent menu alias (/casinobonuses/...). views/page/view.html.php: for topic welcome-packages the head canonical, og:type/og:title/og:url and the WebPage node of the JSON-LD graph take that path; the template's breadcrumb, ItemList and Dataset ids follow it. Every inbound link already used the constant. The public path must resolve on the site side (sh404SEF URL edited to bonuses/welcome-packages, or the menu item under a parent whose alias is bonuses); the old route should 301 to it.
V2.7.77 — Welcome Package Index: restricted-country note - The visitor country comes from the site detector (fec_detect_country: Cloudflare CF-IPCountry, then GeoIP; its own default never counts as a known country). When it is known, a package whose operator excludes that country by its own terms (jReviews jr_restrictedcountries, or the opener bonus country_no, or a country_ok list that omits it; the rule of fec_decide_state, "no-restrictions" never blocked) carries a "Restricted in {Country}" note under the casino name in both tables, with the country name from the site list, and a checkbox "Hide packages restricted in {Country}" joins the controls. The row stays listed and counted: the numbers do not depend on where the reader is. Unknown country = no note, no checkbox. models/packageindex.php data($countrycode) selects ob.country_ok, ob.country_no, jc.jr_restrictedcountries and adds geoBlocked() and the row flag geo_blocked; template data-geo on rows, the client filter and one sentence in the note under the table; page.css .wp-geo, .wp-ctl--check.
V2.7.76 — Welcome Package Index: pages - Both tables page client side, 25 rows per page, with the site .fec-pg pager drawn under each (previous / numbers with ellipsis / next / "Show all N" and back), a "Showing a-b of N" count, page reset on every sort or filter, scroll back to the controls when a page link is below the fold. Server markup is unchanged: without the script every row is visible, and the JSON-LD ItemList still carries them all.
V2.7.75 — Welcome Package Index: casino-level exclusion - models/packageindex.php and AuthorsModelMethodology::getFxrateStats() join #__jreviews_content and drop packages of casinos that are closed (jr_closed set), blacklisted (jr_blacklisted contains bl or yes) or suspended (jr_suspended contains susp): the rule of the bonus listings and of fec_should_noindex_casino(). A casino under review (jr_flag *flagged*) stays listed with an "Under review" mark (.wp-flag). The index template says so under Exclusions. Same rule shipped in fec_fxrate_render.php 1.0.3 (band, casino block, card pill) and fxrate_report.php 1.0.1.
V2.7.74 — FEC Welcome Package Index (FXRate) - New live page topic "welcome-packages" (2.7.74.sql, kind page, sort 26): "FEC Welcome Package Index: Every Multi-Deposit Bonus, Priced", by David Romano, reviewed by Ethan Walker. Menu item to create: Page view, slug welcome-packages, alias welcome-packages under the Bonuses item -> /bonuses/welcome-packages (models/packageindex.php INDEX_PATH). - models/packageindex.php (read-only, static): one query over the active packages and legs, priced with the calculation core components/com_bonuses/helpers/fec_fxrate.php (loaded guarded), same counting rules as the band and the methodology stats. Rows: brand, track, review url, opener bonus url, deposits, advertised text, deposit, effective, first-leg match, turnover, ratio; priced rows effective-desc, unpriced rows brand-asc; stats for the hero and the intro. Core or tables missing = empty state, never a number. - views/page/tmpl/default_welcome-packages.php: hero with live strip, intro (numbers first, "a list, not a ranking"), the index table with client-side order (effective, gap, advertised, deposit, turnover, first deposit, A-Z), deposits filter and casino search (vanilla inline script, server-rendered first paint), "Awaiting terms" table for unpriced packages, how to read, FAQ; JSON-LD: unordered ItemList + Dataset + FAQPage. - assets/page.css section 16 (.wp-*): controls bar, first-leg marker, not-stated state; tables reuse the .pi-* primitives.
V2.7.73 — FXRate methodology (FEC Tools No. 05) - New live topic "fxrate" (2.7.73.sql, sort 37): "How FXRate Works: Welcome Packages, Advertised vs Effective", by David Romano, reviewed by Ethan Walker, rules v1.0 / 2026-10-15. Rendered by views/methodology/tmpl/default_fxrate.php: the principle, why the banner sum is not a rate, the four numbers, two packages worked by hand, the reading rules (missing caps, deposit limits, wagering base, spins, currencies, expired legs, rounding), what FXRate is not, where it appears, where the terms come from, verify-it-yourself, live numbers, FAQ. - AuthorsModelMethodology::getFxrateStats(): one query over the active welcome packages (#__fec_bonus_packages + legs, real rows read through #__bonuses) priced with the calculation core components/com_bonuses/helpers/fec_fxrate.php (loaded guarded): packages tracked/priced, casinos, legs, median advertised and effective match, median and widest ratio, packages below 100% and at 50% or less. Core or tables missing = dashes, never a made-up number. Hooked in views/methodology/view.html.php. - The public band, casino block and card pill live in com_bonuses (fec_fxrate_render.php 1.0.1); this page is what they should link to as the method.
V2.7.72 — Blog posts linked to RTP-verified slots - #__fec_blog_meta.slot_gid / slot_rel (2.7.72.sql): a post points at a #__slot_rtp slot as "game" (about that slot) or "family" (sequel, variant, jackpot network). The desk fills it on save by matching the game name of the title (helpers/blogslot.php: the longest slot name contained in the title; "game" when the part before "by Studio" / the colon is exactly that name); the Details fold gets a "Verified slot" select plus the relation. - Slot page (/slots/<slug>): "From the blog" section after the bonuses, up to 4 posts, the ones about the slot first, each labelled About this slot / Same family; JSON-LD VideoGame gains subjectOf for the "game" posts (BlogPosting @id = post URL + #blogposting, matching fec_blog.php 1.0.9). - The post side (verified RTP box, about/mentions in JSON-LD) is in fec_blog.php 1.0.9. One-off backfill of the 711 imported posts: fec_blog_slot_links.php (dry run + CSV, then --commit).
V2.7.71 — Editorial Standards: How we use AI - New #ai-assistance section after the fact-checking workflow (and in the TOC) plus a "Do you use AI to write reviews?" FAQ entry. It answers the "How" questions of Google's helpful- content guidance (updated 2026-10-05): tools may draft and check, every fact is verified by the signing editor against its primary source, verdicts/flags/scores are human, nothing is published automatically, no invented profiles, portraits or reader reviews. Every sentence is a factual claim about the desk; keep it literally true. Topic stamped v1.3 / 2026-10-13 (2.7.71.sql; fallback in models/methodology.php aligned). Schema unchanged.
V2.7.70 — Blog desk: Draft is a checkbox, one Save button - 2.7.69 moved the state into a hidden field set on click; the script that submits the desk form runs before that click handler, so every save still published. The state is now a Draft checkbox (task_state=draft when ticked): an ordinary field that every submit carries. One Save button whose label follows the box (Publish / Save changes / Save draft / Unpublish to draft). - The edit view falls back on an &n= flag of the redirect URL for its notice when the session notice is missing; every save is logged in one line (blogdesk save user= id= state= ok=). Schema unchanged (2.7.70.sql is a comment).
V2.7.69 — Blog desk: "Save draft" / "Unpublish to draft" lost on submit - A script on the site submits the desk form with form.submit(), which drops the submitter button from the POST (seen live: task_state missing, every save published). The state now travels in a hidden task_state field set by the click on either button (blogdesk.js); the buttons keep task_state_btn for a script-free submit, and the controller prefers the button when it is there. Schema unchanged (2.7.69.sql is a comment).
V2.7.68 — Blog desk: pictures go to images/posts/YYYY/ - images/blog/ was the wrong folder on this host: a rewrite rule sends every path containing "blog/" to /casino-bonus-blog/..., so the uploaded picture 301-ed to a 404 (cPanel error page with its SSI notice). New uploads land in images/posts/YYYY/<alias>.jpg; override with define('FEC_BLOG_IMAGE_DIR', ...). Posts saved with the old path need their picture uploaded again from the desk. Schema unchanged (2.7.68.sql is a comment).
V2.7.67 — Blog desk: links to 410 pages dropped on save - /online-casinos/software|banking|countries|languages|currencies| type, /casino-reviews, /reviews, /countries and any /x/tag path answer 410 Gone in .htaccess. AuthorsHelperBlogtext::cleanHref() now returns '' for those (rule shared with fec_blog.php 1.0.6, FEC_BLOG_GONE_RE), so a pasted or typed link to one of them is unwrapped to plain text, in HTML and in plain mode. Schema unchanged (2.7.67.sql is a comment). The 710 imported posts are cleaned once by scripts/blog/fec_blog_links_410.php.
V2.7.66 — Blog desk: front-end editor of the Casino Bonus Blog - New view=blogdesk (non-SEF, like the other editorial tools: /index.php?option=com_authors&view=blogdesk). Who gets in: a desk user (DASHBOARD_ALLOWED_USERS) sees and edits every blog post and may sign with any active byline or "FreeExtraChips Editorial"; a contributor (Joomla user mapped by casino_authors.joomla_user_id) sees and edits the posts signed by their profile. Guests get the login link; a logged-in user without a profile a dead end. - The editor asks for three things: title, text, picture. The text is pasted HTML (cleaned through a DOM allow-list: p, h2-h4, strong/em, a, lists, blockquote, tables, img from /images) or plain text with light conventions (blank line = paragraph, "## " = section, **bold**, *italic*, "- " lists, "> " quotes, [text](url) and bare URLs). Detection is automatic (structural tags decide), the source text of plain posts is kept for re-editing (fec_blog_meta.source_text). - Everything else is derived on save by helpers/blogtext.php, the importer heuristics ported: intro/fulltext split, meta description (<= 155 chars), kind, provider (title "by Studio", title scan, single studio in the intro; jr_soft options via AuthorsHelperBlogdesk::softMap), Game facts (RTP, volatility, max win, grid, release date; only when stated once). A "Details" fold overrides type and provider; desk users also pick the byline. - #__content row written through JTableContent (asset, alias from the title, unique in the category and never changed on edit, publish_up from a site-local date, scheduling when in the future, draft = state 0, created follows publish_up while unpublished); images JSON from the uploaded picture (GD re-encode, 1600 px long edge, JPEG 85, images/blog/YYYY/<alias>.jpg); metadata.author and created_by_alias/author_id from the byline. Caches cleaned (com_content, page, com_authors). - List: own posts newest first, Published / Scheduled / Draft filter, title search, 25 per page, thumbnail, detected label, views, Edit / View. - 2.7.66.sql (MariaDB): fec_blog_meta.eb_post_id nullable (desk posts have no EasyBlog id), source_mode / source_text columns. - assets/blogdesk.css + blogdesk.js (word count, HTML/plain indicator, image preview, unsaved-text guard, localStorage backup with restore bar, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter publishes).
V2.7.65 — Blog contributors: Nik Davos - 2.7.65.sql seeds the profile of the Casino Bonus Blog's outside contributor (pen name Nik Davos, slug nik-davos, author_type contributor, joined_year 2016, joomla_user_id 9156, bio as he wrote it). Idempotent on the slug; avatar_url left empty until his portrait lands (initials over the type hue meanwhile). - Profile page: new "Blog posts" tab (#__content rows of the blog category signed by the profile, 20 per page, thumbnail + provider/kind label + date, routed through fec_blog.php when installed). It is the landing tab for a profile that has posts and no bonuses. Posts are linked to the profile through #__content.author_id, the FEC byline column (fallback created_by = joomla_user_id when the column is absent), so the "FreeExtraChips Editorial" posts never land on a person. The blog category is excluded from Guides; latest activity considers posts. - Contributor profiles (author_type contributor): hero eyebrow "Contributing writer", pen-name line says "one real writer", stats strip leads with Blog posts and shows only non-zero counters, empty tabs hidden, "Writes for → Casino Bonus Blog" in Quick facts. Editors' pages unchanged apart from the extra Blog posts tab/tile when they have posts. The credentials box badge reads "FXCheck verified" only for authors with bonuses or FXCheck reports, "Signed byline" otherwise. - Team page: "Blog posts" stat and a "Recent posts" list (last 3) on cards without recent bonuses; latest-activity date includes posts. Byline policy paragraph 1 now covers regular contributors (template + menu-param default; an already-saved menu item keeps its stored paragraph until edited in Options → Bylines). - Editorial Standards #bylines: "Contributors, same rules" bullet; topic stamped v1.2 / 2026-10-13 (2.7.65.sql; fallback in models/methodology.php aligned). - AuthorsHelper: blogCatid(), blogOwnerWhere(), contentHasAuthorColumn(), loadBlogHelper(), blogPostUrl(), blogIndexUrl(), blogPostLabel(), blogPostThumb(), blogDate(). bylines.css gains the .au-blog-row / .blog-chip rules.
V2.7.64 — Editions sidebar: label and meta stacked (page.css only) - .pi-editions rows no longer put the label and the meta side by side: in the narrow sidebar column the meta pushed the label into a four-line wrap. Applies to both serial pages.
V2.7.63 — Licence Watch: current edition canonical + permalink - The live URL shows the latest published edition, so its stamped URL (/online-casinos/licence-watch/YYYY-MM) was a self-canonical duplicate until the next edition. Now the stamped page of the current edition canonicalises to the live page; once superseded it canonicalises to itself and the sidebar links it. The sidebar also shows a permalink on the current edition.
V2.7.62 — Edition URLs registered with sh404SEF - sh404SEF has no plugin for com_authors: it builds our URLs through the Joomla router without the menu anchor (an edition came out as /page/<slug>/YYYY-MM) and it decodes only URLs present in its own table, so /online-casinos/<slug>/YYYY-MM was a 404 for both serial pages. New helpers/sef.php (AuthorsHelperSef::registerEdition) writes the record itself: oldurl = the anchored path, newurl = the non-SEF query with the Itemid of the page's menu item; stale 404 records and the stray /page/ form are removed. Called at every Licence Watch freeze and publish (removed on draft deletion) and at every Payout Index freeze, before the bot and the newsletter link to the page. No-op when sh404SEF is not installed.
V2.7.61 — Licence Watch: quarterly licence register with its own editor - New page topic licence-watch (kind='page', 2.7.61.sql seeds the registry row, sort_order 25; hardcoded fallback in models/page.php), template views/page/tmpl/default_licence-watch.php, read-mostly model models/licencewatch.php. Two layers never merged: the declared map (jr_jurisdiction of every LIVE listing: state=1, jr_closed and jr_suspended empty, catid 8) and the verified layer (Operator Atlas current operator links → entities → licences, grouped by regulator family and confidence). Payload also carries the Curacao split (confirmed / pending / unverified claims / ghost sub-licences), Tobique and Anjouan, corporate geography, payment shells, the no-regulator buckets, and the list of listings whose declared licence disagrees with the verified one. - New table #__fec_licence_watch_editions: one row per edition YYYY-MM with status draft|published, frozen payload, diff vs the previous published edition, the Atlas events of the window and the three desk-written sections (overview, quarter, bottom_line, plus an optional title). Drafts render only for the desk user with ?preview=1 (noindex); the live page shows the latest published edition, /online-casinos/licence-watch/YYYY-MM a given one. Every table, figure and register paragraph on the page is generated from the frozen payload; Dataset JSON-LD on published editions; canonical on edition pages. - Router: edition stamps now resolve for any serial topic (fast-payouts, licence-watch), the topic taken from the active menu item's slug; /page/<slug>/YYYY-MM fallback kept. - Task licencewatch.snapshot (key-gated like payoutindex.snapshot, same /home/freeextr/conf/fec_payout_index.php) freezes a draft and emails FEC_PI_NOTIFY_TO; cron on the first day of each quarter. - Desk tab "Licence Watch" in the review dashboard (fec_dash_api.php lw_* and atlas_event_* actions, bundle rebuilt): editions list with Freeze / Refreeze / Edit / Preview / Publish / Delete, the editor with frozen numbers beside three TinyMCE fields, and the Atlas licence-events log (five fields) that feeds the next edition. - assets/page.css: .lw-* (draft banner, logged-events list).
V2.7.60 — Byline policy: portraits wording - Editorial Standards #bylines and the team-page policy box now say what the portraits are ("stylised renderings of the editors themselves, not stock images or invented faces") instead of promising a production method. Template and menu-param defaults aligned; an already-saved menu item keeps its stored paragraph 2 until edited in Options → Bylines. Schema unchanged.
V2.7.59 — Byline policy: pen names declared - Team page: a "Why our editors write under pen names" box under the Bylines section head. States that every name is a professional pen name of one real editor, that editorial responsibility sits with the publisher, that profiles contain nothing invented and no stock or generated portraits, and points to the correction policy. Copy editable from the menu item params (show_bylines_policy, bylines_policy_label, bylines_policy_p1..p3, bylines_policy_link_label, bylines_policy_url); defaults mirrored in the template. - Profile page: one-line "Professional pen name · one real editor behind it · How our bylines work" in the hero, same .au-meta-row rhythm as the Languages line. - Editorial Standards: new "Bylines and pen names" section (#bylines) after Author credentials, listed in the TOC. Topic stamped v1.1 / 2026-10-09 (2.7.59.sql; hardcoded fallback in models/methodology.php aligned). - JSON-LD: Organization gains publishingPrinciples pointing at the Editorial Standards page, on both the team page and the profile page. The Organization @id is shared across com_authors, so the property propagates to the whole graph. Person nodes unchanged: name, url, jobTitle, description, knowsAbout, knowsLanguage, image only when avatar_url is set; no sameAs. - New assets/bylines.css (two patterns, token fallbacks), loaded by views/authors and views/author with the methodology.css cache-buster pattern. Schema unchanged.
V2.7.56 — Payout Index card: font fallback chain - renderCard() no longer requires a serif bold: the resolver walks site fonts (name heuristics), then DejaVu / Liberation in the usual system dirs, then any TTF it can find (bold-ish for bold roles), and only gives up with no TrueType file at all. First dry run on the host reported "no TTF fonts found" because only DejaVu Sans is installed there. Schema unchanged.

V2.7.11 — Asset cache-busting fix - Latent bug: $manifestVersion in dashboard/view.html.php was HARDCODED to '2.7.2' and never bumped. Browsers cached dashboard.js?v=2.7.2 across releases 2.7.3 through 2.7.10, so any JS-side feature shipped in those versions (new dashboard controls, the Create New Game form added in 2.7.10) appeared "broken" until users hard-refreshed. Other view files had no cache-buster at all on their CSS. - Fix: every addStyleSheet/addScript across all views now uses filemtime() of the asset file as the version stamp. Cache invalidates automatically on every file update -> no more manual bump, no more stale-asset bugs. - Files touched: site/views/dashboard, slot, slots, methodology, methodologyhub, methodologyadmin, page.

Selecting "Add a new provider" reveals a free-text input. - Backend: AuthorsModelDashboard::getProviders() and createGameAndStub() inserts into #__games (with MAX(gid)+1, no AUTO_INCREMENT in the legacy schema) then creates the slot_rtp stub via the existing createSlotStub flow. Idempotent on (game_name, provider_value): re-running with same inputs reuses the existing gid. - Provider value is normalised to the *slug* format the legacy table expects (lowercase, hyphenated, asterisks-wrapped). - Two new controller tasks: listProviders (GET) and createGame (POST + CSRF).

V2.7.8 — Methodology cards: version + last_updated + frank refresh - The /methodology hub now renders each card with its version and last_updated date, separated by a thin top border, formatted as "v2.0 · updated 28 May 2026". Reads version/last_updated columns that already exist on #__methodology_topics; the model has been loading them since 2.7.3, only the template was missing the render. - Leading 'v' is stripped before render so legacy values like 'v3' don't show as 'vv3'. - SQL migration 2.7.8.sql refreshes the FRank record (status=external, external_url=/who-is-frank, version=2.0, last_updated=2026-05-28, sort_order=1) and reorders all four cards: FRank, Editorial Standards, RTP Verification, FXCheck. - Backward compatible: records without version or last_updated render without the meta row, identical to 2.7.7 layout.
V2.7.7 — Edit form layout filename fix - Renamed views/methodologyadmin/tmpl/edit.php to default_edit.php. Joomla layout templates follow the naming pattern <layout>_<tpl>.php where <layout> defaults to 'default' and <tpl> is the parameter passed to parent::display($tpl). display('edit') therefore looks up default_edit.php, not edit.php. With the wrong name, JView::display() threw "Layout default_edit not found" on the Edit action. - Lesson (regression #29): Joomla layout files for the same view but different sub-templates must use the default_<suffix>.php naming convention, not just <suffix>.php.
V2.7.6 — Controller whitelist fix - Added 'methodologyadmin' to the allowedViews whitelist in controller.php. Without this, the front controller silently forced view=authors for any methodologyadmin request, regardless of menu/router/Itemid configuration. - Root cause of the "stuck on authors page" issue debugged in V2.7.3 through V2.7.5. The router fix and menu item creation were correct but never reached the view dispatch because controller.php rejected the view name upstream. - Lesson: when adding any new view to the component, four places must be updated together: view class, template, controller.php allowedViews whitelist, and router.php BuildRoute/ParseRoute. Missing the whitelist is the silent failure case.
V2.7.5 — Methodology admin route hardening - Changed the SEF URL for view=methodologyadmin from /editorial/methodologies (V2.7.4) to /methodology-admin (single segment). The /editorial/* path was being captured by an existing Joomla menu alias 'editorial' before this router could run, forcing view=authors regardless of the component router's intent. - Single-segment URLs sit at the same precedence level as the top-level component routes (/authors, /slots, /methodology) and don't conflict with multi-segment menu hierarchies. - Lesson: when adding new SEF URLs, check the live menu tree first. Same regression family as the /slots/p/<provider> path-routing fix in V2.6.x — Joomla menu aliases beat component routers on path prefix match.
V2.7.4 — Router fix for methodologyadmin - Added SEF route /editorial/methodologies → view=methodologyadmin in router.php (both BuildRoute and ParseRoute). - Fixes redirect bug where /index.php?option=com_authors&view=methodologyadmin was being canonicalised by Joomla to /authors?view=methodologyadmin (default Itemid fallback) and then ParseRoute on the 'authors' segment forced view=authors, silently dropping the requested view. Same redirect chain that affects any new view added to the component without an explicit router branch. - Lesson: every new front-end view name needs an entry in both BuildRoute and ParseRoute, even for admin/non-public views that aren't intended to be SEF-friendly. The non-SEF raw URL still gets routed through SEF resolution and falls into the default Itemid trap.
